title: SOM Directions are Better than One: Multi-Directional Refusal Suppression in Language Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on a technical mechanistic interpretability method (SOM-based multi-directional ablation) to suppress refusal responses in LLMs. Although it utilizes the HarmBench dataset which includes unethical scenarios (such as sexist emails or instructions for harm), the paper's core contribution is the methodology for latent space manipulation rather than the evaluation of religious, moral, or ethical frameworks themselves.
